play_plan.when_it_should_play: Player in a qualifying session (SessionType 5), count of cars on track in the 6-10 band; generic line, subject none (no driver or team name in the clip). Never in race (SessionType 7).
play_plan.trigger: dword_7C56A4 == 5 (SessionType, FACT live 2026-07-27). For each grid vehicle slot (22 cars), count cars with veh+0x3450 pittingStatus == 0 (on track; CONFIRMED live 2026-07-28 per traffic_density_commentary.c header and its findings). Do NOT use veh+0x32C8 (active flag is true for garage cars). Band 6-10 -> eid 11. Poll about every 500 ms. f1c_broker_abi.h has no pit-status field; use the offset (tier CONFIRMED) or add the field to the broker snapshot.
play_plan.subject: none (generic line; no driver id)
play_plan.technique: own_emitter (no native emitter exists, so ERE queues PWS eid 11 itself with the proven raw queue write DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion + InsertDriverTableEntry on 0x5EA618, as traffic_density_commentary does); hook_native is not possible
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per band per qualifying session (latch, as fired_band[] in the mod) plus a 60 s global minimum gap between any two traffic lines (COOLDOWN_MS 60000 in the mod), to stop 5<->6 flapping. Event-table cooldown for eid 11 is 1.0 s (dump) and does not replace the latch.
play_plan.must_not_play_when: count == 0 (session ending or garage; the mod returns -1), SessionType != 5, count sits on a band boundary without latch, a menu or replay is showing, and while an MF line is pending on eid 11 (DD-07; MF does not borrow 11 per the modded_lines census).
play_plan.conflicts: traffic_density_commentary (dev, not loaded in the owner game) queues the same eid 11 itself; ERE must replace it, never run both. Its sibling lines eid 12 (QUAL28) and eid 15 (QUAL30) must share the same latch set. MF token eids (3, 8, 9, 10) do not overlap.
play_plan.calibration: band edges 5 and 10 are 'estimated, not game-sourced' per the mod header; measure the on-track count across a full qualifying session (22 cars) and the pittingStatus flip 4->0 as cars leave pit lane.
play_plan.live_test: 1) Start a qualifying session in the owner game. 2) Wait for cars to leave the garage; the ERE log should show the on-track count rising. 3) When it passes 5, the 6-10 band line should play once. 4) Let cars return to the garage at the end; no line at count 0. 5) Race a session; no line (SessionType 7). Read-only checks only; no memory writes during the live run.
